zagreb-cathedral.name: Zagreb Cathedral
zagreb-cathedral.price_text: Free to enter · small fee for treasury, check on the day
zagreb-cathedral.hours: Generally open daily morning to early evening; check on the day
zagreb-cathedral.tip: Look up at the twin spires from Ban Jelačić Square first, then walk up to the door.

st-marks.name: St. Mark's Church
st-marks.hours: Exterior always visible; interior hours vary, check on the day
st-marks.tip: The tiled roof with its coats of arms is the photo — best from the square in front.

gornji-grad.name: Gornji Grad
gornji-grad.tip: Wander the lanes between St. Mark's and the Stone Gate, then take the short funicular down.

broken-relationships.name: Museum of Broken Relationships
broken-relationships.price_text: ≈ EUR 7 adults · check current price on the day
broken-relationships.hours: Generally daily late morning to evening; check on the day
broken-relationships.tip: Small and quirky — allow an hour and read a few stories slowly rather than all of them.

strukli.name: Zagorski Štrukli
strukli.price_text: ≈ EUR 8–15 per portion in a sit-down restaurant
strukli.hours: Restaurant hours vary; lunch and dinner
strukli.tip: Try it savoury with cheese first, then sweet — it is a baked pastry dish from the Zagorje region.

dolac-market.name: Dolac Market
dolac-market.price_text: Free to browse · pay per item
dolac-market.hours: Mornings, roughly Monday to Saturday; quieter on Sunday
dolac-market.tip: Go before noon for the freshest produce and the best people-watching under the red umbrellas.

tkalciceva.name: Tkalčićeva Street
tkalciceva.price_text: Free to walk · cafés and bars extra
tkalciceva.hours: Always open; liveliest in the evening
tkalciceva.tip: This is the café-and-bar strip — grab a coffee by day, a drink on the terrace at night.

ban-jelacic.name: Ban Jelačić Square
ban-jelacic.tip: The main square is your compass — the cathedral, Dolac and the funicular are all a few minutes away.

funicular.name: Zagreb Funicular
funicular.price_text: ≈ EUR 1 per ride · check on the day
funicular.hours: Daytime into evening; check on the day
funicular.tip: One of the shortest public funiculars in the world — ride it up and walk back down through Gornji Grad.

stone-gate.name: Stone Gate
stone-gate.tip: Pause at the shrine inside the gate — it is a quiet spot in the middle of the old town.

lotrscak.name: Lotrščak Tower
lotrscak.price_text: ≈ EUR 3 to climb · check on the day
lotrscak.tip: Climb for a rooftop view over the Lower Town — the noon cannon fires from here daily.
lotrscak.best: Clear daytime; around noon for the cannon

maksimir.name: Maksimir Park
maksimir.tip: A big green escape east of the centre — good for a slow walk or a picnic away from the crowds.
maksimir.best: Morning or late afternoon, spring to autumn

jarun.name: Jarun Lake
jarun.price_text: Free · boat and bike rental extra
jarun.tip: Locals come here to run, cycle and swim — a relaxed half-day if you want a break from sightseeing.

city-walk.name: Free walking tour of the centre
city-walk.price_text: Free to join · tip the guide (≈ EUR 5–15)
city-walk.hours: Usually one or two departures daily; check on the day
city-walk.tip: Tours often start at Ban Jelačić Square — tip in cash and confirm the meeting point the day before.

croatian-history-museum.name: Croatian History Museum
croatian-history-museum.hours: Weekdays and Saturday; closed Sunday; check on the day
croatian-history-museum.tip: A calm, well-labelled overview of Croatian history — good context before you explore further.

mimara.name: Mimara Museum
mimara.hours: Closed Monday; check on the day
mimara.tip: A wide art and artefact collection in a grand building — quiet and uncrowded.

glavni-kolodvor.name: Glavni Kolodvor (Main Station)
glavni-kolodvor.tip: The grand station building is a handy landmark — trams and the airport bus leave from here.

king-tomislav-park.name: King Tomislav Park
king-tomislav-park.tip: A green strip between the station and the centre — a short rest on the walk into town.

zrinjevac.name: Zrinjevac Park
zrinjevac.tip: A tree-lined promenade in the Lower Town — pleasant to walk through on the way to the main square.

art-pavilion.name: Art Pavilion
art-pavilion.price_text: ≈ EUR 6 · varies by exhibition, check on the day
art-pavilion.hours: Closed Monday; check on the day
art-pavilion.tip: Check what exhibition is on — the yellow building itself is worth a look from the park.

tkalca-night.name: Evening drinks on Tkalčićeva
tkalca-night.tip: Pick a terrace and settle in — this is where Zagreb socialises after dark.

trznica-dolac-food.name: Lunch at Dolac and nearby
trznica-dolac-food.tip: Buy fruit at the market, then eat a simple lunch in one of the small places around the square.
